item.title: There’s a ‘monstrous bull market’ developing under the surface of the S&P 500. This hedge-fund manager tells you where it’s at.
item.description: The index may not move much because the stocks with the biggest weightings lag, but there’s a bull market starting to bubble elsewhere, says a hedge-fund manager.
item.dc:creator: Jules Rimmer

item.title: This 30-year market veteran is alarmed by a record-chasing S&P 500. Here’s where he’s investing instead.
item.description: Steven Jon Kaplan sees a completely irrational stock market right now, and investors ignoring a perfectly safe way to play that.
item.dc:creator: Barbara Kollmeyer

item.title: CoreWeave’s AI bonds tumble, raising red flags for the wider market
item.description: CoreWeave’s bonds issued a few months ago fell to 81 cents on the dollar earlier Wednesday, yielding more than 15%.
item.dc:creator: Christine Idzelis
